options.why_wrong: After an inverted 'Had + past participle' condition, the result clause needs 'would have' plus a past participle, not 'would' plus a base verb.

grammar_focus: Inverted third conditional with 'Had + past participle'
explanation: The inverted form 'Had + subject + past participle' replaces 'If ... had known', so the main clause must use 'would have' plus a past participle. Polish speakers may be tempted to use a simple past or present verb here, because Polish marks the condition with a single particle and has no separate auxiliary to match.
